description: Yi is 01.AI's open-weights LLM family founded by Dr. Kai-Fu Lee. Available in 6B, 9B, and 34B sizes with context lengths up to 200K tokens. Bilingual (English/Chinese) with strong reasoning capabilities.

trainingData.description: Trained on 3 trillion multilingual tokens with focus on English and Chinese.

trainingProcedure: Pre-training on diverse corpus. Yi-1.5 includes 500B additional high-quality tokens and 3M fine-tuning samples.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Strong bilingual performance. Yi-34B-200K achieves 99.8% on Needle-in-a-Haystack benchmark for long-context retrieval.

knownLimitations: Bilingual focus (English/Chinese) - less capable in other languages

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Evaluated for bias with mitigation applied.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Safety tuning applied to chat variants.
